Hot & Sour Soup recipe
By: ravikumar
Published: Wednesday, December 27, 2017 - 3:06am

Ingredients




1 Packet Ching's Secret Hot & Sour Soup
4 Cups (800ml) Water

Preparation

1 Step 1: 2 Mix pack content with 4 cups (800ml) of water till there are no loops. 3 Step 2: 4 Bring to boil. Stirring continously. Simmer for 3 minutes. 5 Serve Hot!!

About

Make some delicious and healthy Hot and Sour Soup in just Few Minutest with Chings Secret Hot and Sour Soup. It’s very quick and Easy Hot and Sour Soup recipe to make. Flavor and the texture so smooth and tasty, you will feel to have entire soup bowl in just one sip. Try this Healthy Hot and Sour Soup Recipe and make your loved ones happy.
